events.verdict: Cunningham (DET) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact from Sarr (WAS) as he defends the shot near the rim.
Middleton (WAS) is late to the spot and does not establish himself in a legal guarding position in Green's (DET) path to the contact.
Jenkins (DET) makes contact with McCollum's (WAS) arm, which affects his jump shot attempt.
McCollum (WAS) does not step out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
Cunningham (DET) makes contact with George's (WAS) arm, which affects his jump shot attempt.
Sarr (WAS) initiates contact with Cunningham's (DET) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Robinson (DET) places his hand momentarily on Carrington's (WAS) hip and the contact is marginal.
Jenkins (DET) briefly grasps McCollum's (WAS) jersey before immediately releasing him.
McCollum (WAS) does not step on the midcourt line as he dribbles across the perimeter.
George (WAS) absorbs the contact from Cunningham (DET) and does not make contact with Cunningham's arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Green (DET) legally contests McCollum's (WAS) driving shot attempt.
Middleton (WAS) is moving alongside Cunningham's (DET) path and the contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
George (WAS) contests Cunningham's put-back attempt, and the contact after the release is marginal.
Cunningham (DET) commits a take foul on George (WAS).
Duren (DET) and Champagnie (WAS) come together at the same spot during the inbound, and the foot to foot contact that occurs is incidental.
Champagnie (WAS) pulls Lanier (DET) to the floor during the inbound, and the contact affects his FOM.
Jenkins (DET) does not step out of bounds when he receives the ball.
Carrington (WAS) legally contests Jenkins' (DET) jump shot attempt.
Green (DET) cleanly blocks Sarr's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
George (WAS) cleanly dislodges the ball from Duren (DET) as they pursue the rebound.
Duren (DET) moves into Whitmore's (WAS) body and initiates contact that affects his driving shot attempt.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (offensive basket interference) was confirmed.  Duren (DET) makes contact with the ball while it is still in the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Sarr (WAS) firms up over to his right leg in Jenkins's (DET) path and absorbs the contact.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: George (WAS) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Pistons.
Jenkins (DET) contests the jump shot attempt and allows McCollum (WAS) to return to the floor after the release.
George (WAS) directly contests Green's (DET) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Green's (DET) hand after the release.
Carrington (WAS) commits a take foul on Jenkins (DET).
Champagnie (WAS) commits a take foul on Duren (DET).
Jenkins (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to the Wizards.
Jenkins (DET) momentarily applies his hand to George's (WAS) side as they move in the same direction during the inbound, and the contact is marginal.
George (WAS) is bracing for the contact from Jenkins (WAS) and the contact as he releases away into his spin move is marginal.
Green (DET) legally contests McCollum's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
McCollum (WAS) commits a take foul on Reed (DET).
Sarr (WAS) cleanly dislodges the ball from Duren (DET).
